answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The grove graph is validated at intake and the orchard frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and pulse anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 17 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 673 takes that multiplied out, plus 127 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
